title: Mysterious Elixir

sources.title: Feign Death
markers: | summary = It allows spellcasters to put their allies into a magical, protective coma, feigning death.

summary: Use this single-use elixir to apply Feigning Death to yourself or a nearby ally.

fields.Use: Action, melee range. The item behaves like a Scroll of Feign Death. For 10 turns the target enters a protective coma, resists all damage except Psychic, and ignores disease and poison effects. Help ends it early. It does not force enemies to stop attacking.
fields.Acquisition: A desk in the Chamberlain’s Office in Szarr Palace.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
